name: fetch_user_feedback_sample_issues
description: Fetches sample issues reported by user feedback without verbose log details.

agentId.description: Required. Unique identifier of the agent/partner.

firstDate.description: Optional. Starting calendar day in "YYYY-MM-DD" format (UTC). Filters for issues occurring on or after this date.

lastDate.description: Optional. Ending calendar day in "YYYY-MM-DD" format (UTC). INCLUSIVE: Filters for issues occurring on or before this calendar date.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of items to return in a single response. Defaults to 50 if not specified. The maximum allowed page size is 1000.

skip.description: Optional. Number of records to skip from the beginning of the result set. Useful for pagination (e.g., skip = page_size * page_number).

symptom.description: Optional. Filter results by specific symptom/issue type.
